---
title: "Overview of Ecosystem Service: Non-Timber Forest Products"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    standalone: true
---

Non-timber forest products cover what forests yield other than wood. The account values them per
hectare of forest people can actually reach. The base year is 2019 and the price convention
recorded in `es_config.csv` is `value per accessible hectare`.

## Quantity

Hectares of accessible forest. Forest is the ESA CCI class range 50 to 90 inclusive. Accessible
means inside a 10 km buffer around roads and rivers. The source repository, `geo_ntfp`, implements
that intersection two ways, a vector-buffer calculation and a distance-raster calculation, and commits no
output from either. The library therefore runs both variants and presents both, following the
pattern fire protection uses for its variants.

## Price

The CWoN 2024 non-wood forest product value per hectare per country, in current USD, read at the
GEP base year.

## Valuation

`ntfp_gep_by_country` filters the value series to the base year, joins it onto the accessible-area
table by country label, and multiplies:

$$
\text{NTFP GEP} = \text{accessible forest (ha)} \times \text{NWFP value (USD/ha)}
$$

The function is in place and unit-tested.

## Inputs

From `es_parameters.csv`, scoped to the `ntfp` service:

- `ntfp_roads_region1_path`, the GRIP4 Region 1 vector geodatabase, with a `_source_url` row
  pointing at the public PBL download.

## Output

`gep_by_country_base_year.csv` in the `gep_calculation` task directory, holding the country label,
the accessible forest hectares, the value per hectare and `ntfp_gep`. It is not yet produced.

## Method constants

- `NTFP_ACCESS_BUFFER_M = 10_000`, the accessibility buffer around roads and rivers.
- `ESA_FOREST_CLASS_MIN = 50` and `ESA_FOREST_CLASS_MAX = 90`, the inclusive ESA CCI forest class
  range.

## Taken as given

The CWoN NWFP value-per-hectare series.

## What is open

The accessibility raster stage is being ported and is not yet built, so `gep_calculation` raises
`NotImplementedError` naming exactly what is missing rather than emitting a partial number.

The committed roads file is unusable, because only the sidecar files were committed and the `.shp`
itself never was. The accessibility stage therefore runs on a public global roads dataset, and the
original roads file remains a replication ask.

The CWoN value-per-hectare table has no `es_parameters.csv` row yet, so the price side of the
valuation has no recorded path.
